items.name: Content team
items.description: An editor, a researcher and a writer that plan a content calendar and draft posts and articles in your voice for your approval.

items.name: Research team
items.description: A research lead, an analyst and a fact checker that turn a question into a sourced written report.

items.name: Release team
items.description: A release manager, a QA engineer and a notes writer that verify a build and prepare the changelog and a go/no-go summary.
